title: Salvianolic acid B noncovalently interacts with disordered c-Myc: a computational and spectroscopic-based study.
authors: Singh, Ashutosh; Kumar, Ankur; Kumar, Prateek; Bhardwaj, Taniya; Giri, Rajanish; Garg, Neha
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨小分子Salvianolic acid B与无序c-Myc蛋白的相互作用，虽涉及分子对接与模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Aims: c-Myc, along with its partner MAX, regulates the expression of several genes, leading to an oncogenic phenotype. The MAX interacting interface of c-Myc is disordered and uncharacterized for small molecule binding. Salvianolic acid B possesses numerous therapeutic properties, including anticancer activity. The current study was designed to elucidate the interaction of the Sal_Ac_B with the disordered bHLH domain of c-Myc using computational and biophysical techniques. Materials & methods: The binding of Sal_Ac_B with Myc was studied using computational and biophysical techniques, including molecular docking and simulation, fluorescence lifetime, circular dichroism and anisotropy. Results & conclusions: The study demonstrated a high binding potential of Sal_Ac_B against the disordered Myc peptide. The binding of the compounds leads to an overall conformational change in Myc. Moreover, an extensive simulation study showed a stable Sal_Ac_B/Myc binding.
abstract_zh: 目的：c-Myc与其伙伴MAX共同调控多个基因的表达，导致致癌表型。c-Myc的MAX相互作用界面呈无序状态，且尚未表征其与小分子结合的特性。丹酚酸B具有多种治疗特性，包括抗癌活性。本研究旨在利用计算和生物物理技术阐明Sal_Ac_B与c-Myc无序bHLH结构域之间的相互作用。材料与方法：通过计算和生物物理技术，包括分子对接与模拟、荧光寿命、圆二色性和各向异性，研究了Sal_Ac_B与Myc的结合。结果与结论：研究表明Sal_Ac_B对无序Myc肽具有高结合潜力。化合物的结合导致Myc整体构象发生变化。此外，广泛的模拟研究显示Sal_Ac_B/Myc结合稳定。
